build_translation_feature: build a Translation feature with fixed languages like en, fr, de for a HuggingFace dataset
build_translation_variable_languages_fea: build a TranslationVariableLanguages feature with variable languages per example for a HuggingFace dataset
encode_translation_example: encode a translation dictionary into sorted language and translation lists using TranslationVariableLanguages encode_example
flatten_translation_feature: flatten a Translation feature into a dictionary of string Value features for each language
get_pyarrow_schema_for_translation: get the PyArrow struct schema for a Translation feature by calling the Translation instance
